notes.subject: נשא פנים
notes.rationale: 'Go godiša sefahlego' — temanedumo ya go bontšha lehlakore; ka Sepedi: go ema lehlakoreng la gagwe.

notes.subject: אם
notes.rationale: E ka ba potšišo ('na?') goba kopanyi ('goba') — ditlhahlobo tše dingwe di e bea bjalo ka potšišo.

notes.subject: go baetapele ba Job
notes.rationale: Potšišo e bolelelwa bafeti ba Job — go lwantšha ka go tswalana le El.

translation: Na le tla ema lehlakoreng la gagwe, goba le ka loa bakeng sa El?
